Date: 2029-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro call today at 9:30am PT — short agenda attached

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for booking time today (9:30am PT). Quick agenda so we make the most of 30 minutes:
- 5m intros / outcomes
- 10m high-level walkthrough of Redwood Inference: latency, dedicated capacity, and private deployments
- 10m sketch of how Novaflow’s usage pattern could map to Dedicated vs Hosted
- 5m next steps / questions

I attached a brief agenda and a one-pager with example latency/cost profiles to speed things up (discovery-agenda.pdf). If anything shifts, ping me here; otherwise I’ll join the Zoom link in the invite.

See you soon —

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: 2029-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick note — we missed you at 9:30 (three restart options)

Hi Olivia —

I waited in the meeting for about 8 minutes but it looks like something came up on your side. No worries — I know calendar chaos happens. I wanted to propose three quick ways to pick this back up depending on what’s easiest for you: 

1) Rapid follow-up (15m) — I can jump on a quick 15-minute call today or tomorrow to run a tight intro and surface any must-knows. Book a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/priyom-15

2) Self-serve sandbox + async recap — if you prefer to poke around first, I can spin up a sandbox preview for Novaflow and send a 3–4 minute walkthrough recording. Useful if you want to validate latency and embeddings without scheduling. Link I’ll send if you pick this path.

3) Pick a time next week — if you want a fuller conversation with an AE present, I can loop Marissa and we’ll find a 30–45m slot that works. Suggested windows: Tue/Wed (7/2–7/3) mornings PT.

Tell me which path works and I’ll take care of the rest. If there’s anything specific you wanted to cover (data residency, SOC 2, or model customization), mention it and I’ll make sure the right folks join.

Thanks — sorry we missed each other.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Sorry about that — I was pulled into an urgent ops call and couldn’t make it out in time. Appreciate the follow up.

Option 3 works best for us: we’d like the AE to be on the call. Our team is free Tue 7/2 between 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 7/3 after 13:00 PT. If neither fits, I can also do a 30m block on Thu 7/4 in the morning.

A couple of quick things to prep for the AE: Novaflow processes customer logs that contain hashed PII; we need to understand private deployment and retention controls.

Thanks —
Olivia Turner
Product Manager, Novaflow
